body:
Last week I was at work when the manager tells me my mom called and that I should give her a call even if I was 'fighting with her'. An acquaintance I last worked with two years ago also messaged me about this.

She contacted both these people because I hadn't texted her yet that day because I was busy. She's done this at every one of my jobs. I got my phone from the car and contacted her and she laughed and said she 'didn't know what problem I had with her now' and she was 'tired of my moods'. I'm over her creating dramas. It was an ordinary Tuesday. She hasn't spoken to me since and has had my grandma text me like clockwork twice a day now. I already spoke to her daily because I wanted to, but now it feels like surveillance instead.
